ei.title: An Unexpected Call on a Day Off
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.

I was really concerned since he had just ④<u>recovered</u> from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② muting → muted: arrived와 and로 병렬된 과거동사
det.analysis:
❌ ① arrived: 'I arrived at the nail salon' 과거동사, 정상
✅ ② muting → muted: 'arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone' — 앞의 과거동사 arrived와 and로 병렬되므로 muted. 현재분사 muting은 병렬 구조를 깨뜨림 ← 정답
❌ ③ had fallen: 'had fallen over a stone' 과거완료, 정상
❌ ④ recovered: 'had just recovered' 과거완료, 정상
det.tip: A and B 병렬: arrived(과거) and muted(과거)

❌ ② checked: 'I checked my cellphone' 과거동사, 정상
❌ ③ seated: 'now seated on a bench' 과거분사, 정상
✅ ④ has just recovered → had just recovered: 걱정한(was concerned) 과거 시점보다 회복이 먼저이므로 과거완료 had. 현재완료 has는 시제 오류 ← 정답

As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 평화로운 휴일이 부상 소식으로 걱정으로 바뀌었다는 요지
det.analysis:
❌ ① 휴대폰 끄기: 요지 아님
❌ ② 네일샵 추천: 요지 아님
❌ ③ 걷기 주의: 세부 사항
✅ ④ 평화롭던 휴일이 가족의 부상 소식으로 한순간에 걱정으로 바뀌었다: 편안함 → 걱정의 반전 ← 정답
det.tip: 요지: 평화로운 휴일 → 걱정으로 반전

ch: 휴일에는 반드시 휴대폰을 꺼 두어야 한다.
무릎 수술 후에는 특히 조심히 걸어야 한다.
평화롭던 휴일이 가족의 부상 소식으로 한순간에 걱정으로 바뀌었다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

그 시간 동안 (연결이) 단절될 수 있도록

[조건] (1) be, disconnected, for, hour, I, so, that, the, would를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 9단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: so that I would be disconnected for the hour
det.analysis:
본문: 'so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm' — 목적 부사절 so that + 주어 + would + be disconnected(수동)

[조건 검증] so(1) that(2) I(3) would(4) be(5) disconnected(6) for(7) the(8) hour(9) = 9단어
det.tip: so that + 주어 + would ~ = ~하도록 (목적) / be disconnected = 단절되다(수동)
